Description: Annie Beaumont and Oswald talk in the Chapel, discussing family history, the dead, and the truth behind the curse. After thunder, Annie Beaumont realizes No. 3 has died and begins to notice she has forgotten the conversation, indicating that the curse includes forgetting.
Location: Chapel（Chapel）
Key Information:
  - Annie Beaumont and Oswald discuss the family’s history—especially clues about Tony Dauer, the gun, and family portraits. However, Annie no longer remembers Tony Dauer, while No. 3 recalls No. 4.
  - Oswald says he once saw Tony Dauer holding a gun in Tony’s room.
  - Oswald says the house has been cursed since his sister died. Annie feels her memory becoming hazy, seemingly affected by the curse.
  - The thunder-as-death pattern appears again, implying No. 3 (Oswald) has died.
  - After the thunder, Annie realizes she has forgotten parts of what Oswald just said, further indicating the curse causes forgetting.
  - Annie Beaumont recalls Oswald, causing the curse to spread.
  - Oswald warns that if Annie cannot remember the past, she will face a fate worse than death; Annie feels she is gradually losing her memory.
Characters:
  [Annie Beaumont（Annie Beaumont）] Person No. 2, a resident affected by the curse and gradually losing her memory.
    · Discusses family secrets with Oswald and recalls the dead and the family’s past.
    · After thunder, realizes she has forgotten part of what Oswald said and recognizes the curse’s influence.
    · Feels her memory slipping away and fears being completely erased by the curse.
  [Oswald（Oswald）] Person No. 3, a member connected to Annie’s family, who reveals family secrets.
    · Discusses the family’s past with Annie and emphasizes that the house has been cursed since his sister died.
    · Warns Annie that if she cannot remember the past, she may face a fate worse than death.
    · Dies after the thunder, implying the curse kills people in descending number order.
    · Warns Annie that if she cannot preserve memory, she will be doomed to forgetting.
